scripts.deploy:web: pnpm run check && pnpm --filter web exec wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:collector: pnpm run check && pnpm --filter collector run deploy
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:data-ops && pnpm --filter web run cf-typegen && pnpm --filter collector run cf-typegen && pnpm --filter web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter collector exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run build:data-ops && pnpm --filter collector test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter collector exec wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter collector exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to ../web/.wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter collector exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:data-ops && node scripts/seed-browser-tests.mjs && IPTRACK_E2E=1 pnpm --filter web build && playwright test
